statement_en: Two papers describe acclimation practices for mandarin fish: using anti-stress products and feeding live fish after the fish are moved into tanks, and weekly density and disturbance stress training to build tolerance for later handling such as tank moves and transport. Both are presented as supportive, but the claims only describe the practices and report no measured welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 两篇论文介绍了鳜鱼的抗应激驯化做法：一是进箱初期使用抗应激产品并投喂活鱼，帮助鱼适应环境；二是每周进行一次密度胁迫和扰动应激驯化，以提高鱼对搬池、运输等后续操作的耐受能力。两者都被认为有帮助，但这些说法只是描述做法，没有给出实测的福利效果。
